name: NVIDIA A100, llama.cpp Vulkan (2257758, coopmat2): Llama-2-7B Q4_0 tg128 t/s
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (llama.cpp discussion #10879 Vulkan scoreboard, commit 2257758, coopmat2). Llama-2-7B Q4_0, -ngl 99 -fa 0, tg128 = 160.78 ± 0.16 t/s. Scoreboard lists the chip only as 'Nvidia A100' — filed under the 40GB SXM4 record; the 40GB PCIe and 80GB SKUs share the same GA100 die and differ mainly in HBM capacity, so the decode figure is representative to ~first order.
notes: VARIANT AMBIGUITY: scoreboard does not record which A100 SKU (40GB PCIe / 40GB SXM4 / 80GB). Decode tok/s is bandwidth-bound; all A100 SKUs are 1555-2039 GB/s so the figure is broadly representative but the 80GB HBM2e SKU would edge higher.
